services.name: Lynnville Tour - Big Machine Distillery
services.desc: Where it All Started! Lynnville, TN Adult (Ages 21+): $25 (Tour and Tasting) Minor (Under Age 21): Free! About The backbone of distillation for Big Machine Distillery is located in the romantically-preserved town of Lynnville, TN. One hour south of Nashville on the whiskey trail, Big Machine Distillery (formerly Tenn South Distillery) features a picturesque 28 acres of rural farmland in the Tennessee countryside. Here is where our 20,000 square-foot distillery and tasting room preserve the romantic origins of our hand-made craft spirits. For groups of 20 or more, please contact The Original Big Machine Distillery & Tasting Room
